title: Honey Mustard Salad with Tomato, Avocado, Crispy Chickpeas, Egg & Feta

steps.text: Drain and rinse chickpeas, then transfer to a large baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, season with garlic powder and salt, then stir to coat; spread out in an even layer.

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until chickpeas are golden and crispy, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Roughly chop eggs. Place on a large plate.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise. Add to the plate with the egg.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the plate and set aside.
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces.
To serve, divide lettuce between plates or bowls; top with tomatoes, avocado, crispy chickpeas, eggs, and feta. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy!
